summary: Navigation between pages of a long list: a landmark holding page links, previous and next links, and gaps. Seven custom elements.

label.note: Accessible name of the navigation landmark. Translate it for other languages.

anatomy.name: nav
anatomy.notes: Native <nav> in the shadow root; named by label.

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: label prop (default "pagination"). Give each pagination on a page a distinct label.

keyboard.Tab: moves through the links in order

aria: root: native nav landmark with aria-label
content: role=list; item: role=listitem (set on the hosts, which resolve across the shadow roots in the flat tree)
link: native a; the current page has aria-current="page"

previous and next: named by the slotted text when no label is set (WCAG 2.5.3 label in name); an explicit label becomes the aria-label; with no slotted text the name is "Go to previous page" / "Go to next page"
ellipsis: aria-hidden, decorative; "More pages" stays in the DOM as visually hidden text
sb-pagination-content and sb-pagination-item set role=list and role=listitem only when the author set no role

elements.summary: One entry of the row: a link, a previous or next link, or a gap.
A link to one page. The current page is filled and marked.

href.note: Target of the link. Without it the anchor is not a link. javascript:, vbscript: and data: URLs are dropped: the link renders without href and a console warning names it (SB-0115).

active.note: The current page: aria-current="page" and the outlined look.

size.note: icon is a 36px square for page numbers; medium is padded for words.

elements.notes: Own anchor, not sb-button: Button cannot forward aria-current to its inner link.

elements.summary: Link to the previous page, with a chevron and text.

href.note: Target of the link. javascript:, vbscript: and data: URLs are dropped: the link renders without href and a console warning names it (SB-0115).

label.note: Accessible name override. Without it the slotted text names the link (so the visible text is always in the name); with no slotted text the name is "Go to previous page". Translate it, keep the visible text inside it.

elements.summary: Link to the next page, with text and a chevron.

href.note: Target of the link. javascript:, vbscript: and data: URLs are dropped: the link renders without href and a console warning names it (SB-0115).

label.note: Accessible name override. Without it the slotted text names the link (so the visible text is always in the name); with no slotted text the name is "Go to next page". Translate it, keep the visible text inside it.

elements.summary: A gap standing for skipped pages.

label.note: Visually hidden text. The element is hidden from assistive technology.

useCases.when: A list or table split over several pages
useCases.use: sb-pagination with previous, links, ellipsis and next

antiPatterns.why: They are not links: no keyboard focus and no navigation

antiPatterns.pattern: Two paginations on one page with the same label
antiPatterns.why: Screen reader users cannot tell the landmarks apart
antiPatterns.alternative: Set a distinct label on each

coverage: navigation landmark, list, listitems; label renames the landmark
active: aria-current and outlined look from tokens
previous and next names, visible text, translated labels
ellipsis aria-hidden, text kept, absent from the accessibility tree
previous and next named by slotted text without a label; author role kept on content and item

the visual reference uses the border color, which is below 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11)
the visual reference uses a translucent ring

drift.realization: Links take hover and focus only in code; the set has no State axis for them.

openQuestions.question: Reuse sb-button with href for the links?
openQuestions.answer: No: sb-button forwards only aria-label, so aria-current="page" would sit on a generic host. The link renders its own anchor with the same look from pagination tokens.

openQuestions.question: Are the ellipsis words read by assistive technology?
openQuestions.answer: No: the element is aria-hidden; "More pages" stays as visually hidden text in the DOM.

openQuestions.question: List semantics across shadow roots?
openQuestions.answer: role=list and role=listitem on the content and item hosts; the flat tree puts the link inside the item.
